sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Celidon, also called Cellydon, is an Arthurian site. Like the legendary forest of Brocéliande in Brittany, the woods of Celidon in Britain appear in several legends. Their actual location is not known. An important battle took place there. King Arthur's knights won that battle. The magician Merlin wandered these woods during his period of madness.
